About the chapter

AMA at Georgia State gives students the resources and skills to shape the marketing industry. We connect like-minded students, share what we know, and offer training and hands-on experience across every part of the field.

Members hear directly from industry professionals and build a network of marketing contacts for the careers ahead. #thisisyourcommunity
